test_tokenize_string: test the tokenize_string function to split a string into individual tokens including punctuation and spaces
test_detokenize_string: test the detokenize_string function to reconstruct the original string from a list of tokens
test_process_string: test the process_string function to apply tokenization with custom character-to-token and token-to-character mappings
test_java_tokenizer_discarding_comments: test the Java tokenizer to verify it correctly discards comments and tokenizes strings
test_string_tokenization_invertible: test that tokenizing then detokenizing a string produces the original input unchanged
